reason: Preds have won 7 straight and Saros (.922) tops Askarov (.894). San Jose is on the second night of a back-to-back after a shootout in Utah.
short: 7 straight wins, Sharks on a B2B
analysis: Nashville rolls into San Jose on a seven-game win streak, 8-1-1 in its last 10 at 11-4-5 with a +7 goal differential. The Sharks are 9-11-2 with a -20 goal differential and 3-6-1 in their last 10, though they won a 6-5 shootout in Utah on Saturday, so this is the second night of a back-to-back for them while the Preds are rested. Juuse Saros is at .922 against Yaroslav Askarov at .894 (neither confirmed at pick time, and San Jose may start its backup). Jonathan Marchessault is day-to-day for Nashville; San Jose is without Alexander Wennberg. Books have Nashville at -160. Pretend stakes: $60 on the Preds to win, $20 on Nashville -1.5 at +148.
